cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your inspection of my new flat is almost approved. Just check that window latch before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's shut. Can I leave now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Departure is pending. Why is the curtain moving?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Explanation approved. You may show me which switch turns it off; there are several. Then I'll be ready to release you.
